highlights.reason_zh: textGrain 已进入实际开放，但改写脆弱性和封闭检测器决定它目前只能 WATCH。
highlights.reason_en: textGrain has entered rollout, but rewrite fragility and a restricted detector keep it at WATCH.

highlights.reason_zh: Qwen Code 0.25 把多 agent 协作、冷恢复和副作用控制推入稳定版。
highlights.reason_en: Qwen Code 0.25 moves multi-agent collaboration, cold restore and side-effect controls into stable.

highlights.reason_zh: vLLM 0.31 同时推进快速恢复与更安全的多模态请求边界。
highlights.reason_en: vLLM 0.31 advances both fast recovery and safer multimodal request boundaries.

highlights.reason_zh: Private Safety Processing 从预览进入分阶段开放，并给出三家云的部署路径。
highlights.reason_en: Private Safety Processing moves from preview into phased rollout with setup paths for three clouds.

highlights.reason_zh: AutoTrust 模型的高下载量与弱验证形成鲜明反差，明确判断为 IGNORE。
highlights.reason_en: AutoTrust models pair high downloads with weak validation, supporting an explicit IGNORE judgment.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并读完；另核查官方发布、代码仓库与到期复核。处理 4 项复核任务。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and read, supplemented by official releases, repositories and due reviews. Four review tasks were processed.
